ablation_plan.expected_effect: Removing capacity coupling lets greedy assignment saturate coverage, collapsing the score gap between starter and upper.
ablation_plan.name: decoupled-capacity

ablation_plan.expected_effect: Removing target weighting makes all lawful full-cover plans equivalent, so the interior lever stops improving the score.
ablation_plan.name: flat-targets

ablation_plan.expected_effect: Keeping assignments fixed after repair removes most of the interior-to-upper score span.
ablation_plan.name: no-repair

cheap_baseline.domain_fit: Allocation tasks of this shape admit off-the-shelf greedy and local-search heuristics; the baseline mirrors what a competent practitioner tries first.
cheap_baseline.method: Deterministic greedy-by-weight with one pass of swap-based local repair, bounded to a small iteration budget.

coupling_mechanism: Assignments compete for shared capacity while weighted targets force trade-offs, so fixing one conflict shifts violation pressure elsewhere and local greedy moves cannot jointly optimize coverage and capacity.
improvement_levers: replace low-value assignments with higher-value assignments
repair capacity conflicts without discarding valid work
long_horizon_reason: The agent can repeatedly diagnose uncovered targets, rebalance capacity, and submit improved plans.
real_work: Improve a deterministic allocation plan against weighted targets and capacity constraints.
real_world_consequence: Poor plans leave high-priority demand uncovered while consuming scarce capacity.

upper.description: Deterministic exhaustive reference on the generated miniature instances.
